sources.note: Confirms QSP, a 2024 investment, is one three-facility Northern Virginia joint venture among Wren House, QTS and another investor. It does not disclose Wren House's percentage. Use this as the primary identity and current-status source.

sources.label: Wren House QSP completion announcement
sources.note: Confirms the November 13, 2024 completed recapitalization, that Wren House and another fund acquired a majority stake, that QTS retained ownership and operating roles, and that the three facilities total about 100 MW. It does not disclose a 40% Wren House stake.

sources.label: CBRE H2 2024 data-center report
sources.verificationMethod: indexed direct page and official CBRE Washington release
sources.note: Identifies Wren House and BlackRock as the investor pair in the $1.2 billion QTS joint venture for a majority stake in three stabilized Northern Virginia data centers.

sources.label: Paul Weiss transaction experience
sources.note: Corroborates BlackRock Global Infrastructure Fund's direct investment in the Wren House/QTS joint venture and the three-facility boundary.

sources.label: KBRA preliminary rating release
sources.note: Supports the financing and three-property collateral boundary.

sources.label: KBRA current surveillance release
sources.note: As of November 13, 2025, confirms the same three facilities, 690,770 square feet and 99.6 MW. It identifies sponsor affiliates of QTS, Blackstone and BlackRock; Wren House's direct page separately establishes Wren House participation.

sources.label: Blackstone QTS acquisition completion
sources.note: Confirms Blackstone affiliates completed the QTS acquisition on August 31, 2021, supporting Blackstone only as upstream QTS owner rather than substituting for direct BlackRock JV participation.

materialCorrections.reason: Neither the current Wren House QSP page nor its completion announcement discloses 40%. The searches found no reliable direct or transaction-level source for that percentage.

conclusion: The PROPOSED_MERGE identity decision is strongly supported: the census label and canonical QSP are the same three-facility Northern Virginia investment, and later task 491 is duplicate coverage. Current direct evidence supports Wren House participation, BlackRock as the other direct investor, and QTS as retained owner/operator with Blackstone upstream. All direct JV percentages remain not publicly disclosed; the model's 40% Wren House claim must not be persisted.
